### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues block the opt-in occurrence-sensitive text-matching change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Adds opt-in occurrence-sensitive coverage to `ApproximateTextMatching`, addressing repeated-target overcrediting from #3912 while preserving default behavior and existing scorer identifiers. **Changes:** - Counts overlapping n-gram occurrences when `occurrence_sensitive=True`, capping credit at the counts present in the response. - Includes the new mode in identifier parameters only when enabled. - Adds regression tests for repeated targets, embedded matches, threshold boundaries, overlapping windows, and backward compatibility. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​unit/​analytics/​test_text_matching.py` | Adds occurrence-sensitive coverage and compatibility tests. | | `pyrit/​common/​text_matching.py` | Implements and documents the optional matching mode and identifier handling. |
Review effort: Balanced
